text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our three-legged race as trainer and 
trainee was finally about to begin. Then, 
one day, the academy's trainers were 
called together. There, we were introduced 
to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They were Ryoka Tsurugi, the event 
producer, and Sonnet Elfie, a popular 
athlete-type UmaTuber.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They announced the launch of the "U.A.F.", 
a sports entertainment event where athlete 
Umamusume compete across 15 different 
disciplines.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to establish this tournament as a 
new form of entertainment alongside races, 
Tracen Academy seems to have decided to 
support it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was said to be a massive project, 
holding a test tournament this year, 
followed by two years of qualifiers and 
finals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though participation in the U.A.F. is 
optional, competing against Umamusume 
athletes across a wide variety of 
disciplines is an invaluable experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Participating might provide "something" 
that could be utilized in <chrname>'s races. First, 
we must discern what that is in the trial 
tournament.
